body: Audit (schema read 6 Nov 2026): migration 0001 gives person.federation_ok a default of 1 (and GET /me returns federationOk: true for everyone), while PRIVACY.md and docs/13 describe friends on other servers as something that is turned on, after both people agree. Nothing reads the column yet; when federation is built, make the default 0 (a new migration) so that the first build cannot treat every existing person as having agreed.
